## Project focus

This culminating experience project examines how a local orthodontic practice can improve online visibility and website usability for San Gabriel and Chino Hills audiences.

My AO1 work focuses on navigation, calls to action, mobile experience, and trust-building information. See the [dashboard](../dashboard.qmd) for an illustrative summary.
